head: 20a8a3f
milestone_full: 184 Hong Kong chapters ship in three arms (Traditional HK / opencc Simplified fold / full English prose), with the atlas in lockstep at 184/184/184 and a derived fence. TWO curated arcs now walk the corpus: the ticket arc (179-183, one object across a whole day) and the crossing arc (64-61-62-65-67, one border from midnight into the morning - Man Kam To's first rice truck at 00:45, the Huanggang night gate at 02:45, the night market below Lo Wu at 03:45, Ho Ming's third run at 07:15, his second truck out at 08:15). Chapter 184 closes the ticket's story: at 23:30 the ticket that carried only a time is claimed at the Central terminus, and a fresh ticket is weighted on the corner. Both rails are curated, server-rendered walks available from any of their chapters - no model, no network, no client state; titles derive from the live locale corpus so a rename can never leave a stale string. The stack was siege-tested at PRODUCTION rate limits: 2,702 credential-stuffing requests ALL 429 at p50=25 ms, zero 5xx, read plane 244/244 at p50=8 ms throughout. Spring Cloud edge (Eureka / Config / Gateway / OpenFeign / LoadBalancer / resilience4j), 12 StateGraph lanes, admin behavior analytics with password 123, an embedded handbook teaching both arcs, and an English arm enforced by contract. The gpt-6.2-sol API was CLOSED by directive: all recent work is code-and-rules only. verify_all NO OFFENDER, 1,005 web tests, 38k AI tests green.
headline: 184 Hong Kong chapters in three arms · two curated arcs walkable (ticket 179-183, crossing 64-67) · production-limit siege: 2,702 stuffing requests ALL 429 at p50=25ms, zero 5xx, read plane 244/244 · Spring Cloud edge + 12 StateGraph lanes · 1,005 web tests + 38k AI green · LLM API closed.
features: D1568: chapter 184 - the ticket's coda: the time-only ticket is claimed at 23:30 and a fresh one is weighted on the desk corner; count ripple clean to 184.
D1567: the crossing arc - five border chapters (64, 61, 62, 65, 67) form one border's night into morning; the arc primitive is now shared (story-arc.ts) and the handbook teaches both arcs.
D1563: the ticket arc - five chapters (179-183), one object, a whole day, made walkable from any of its chapters; curated, server-rendered, local-only.
D1541: siege re-measured at PRODUCTION limits - stuffing 2,702 ALL 429 at p50=25ms; read plane 244/244 throughout, zero 5xx.
D1538: FactBundle lazy attribute index + ranking-weights mtime cache - per-request Python CPU ~107ms -> ~30ms, measured in-process.
milestone_full_zh: 184 章香港系列三語臂（繁體香港／opencc 簡體／完整英文），圖譜鎖步 184/184/184，圍欄數字由索引推導。兩條策展弧可沿章節走完：「票之弧」（179–183，一件東西走過一整天）與「渡之弧」（64–61–62–65–67，一道口岸由午夜走到早晨——文錦渡零點四十五分的第一班米車、皇崗夜閘、羅湖橋下夜市、浩明第三班折返、第二輛米車出閘）。第 184 章寫尾聲：23:30，那張只寫了時間的票在中環終點站被人認走，收車司機把新票壓在桌角。兩條弧皆為策展式、服務端渲染，標題由當前語言語料即時推導；零模型、零網絡、零客戶端狀態。以生產級限流實測攻城：2,702 發撞庫全部 429（p50=25ms、零 5xx），讀面全程 244/244（p50=8ms）。Spring Cloud 邊緣、12 條 StateGraph、密碼 123 的管理員行為分析、教兩條弧的嵌入式說明書、契約測試強制英文臂。gpt-6.2-sol API 已按指令關閉：近期工作皆為純程式與規則。verify_all 全綠、web 1,005、AI 38k 全綠。

D1567：「渡之弧」——五個口岸章（64、61、62、65、67）連成口岸的一夜到早；弧原語下沉為共享模組，說明書教兩條弧。
